summary: Funded 2–3 month summer research internship at a German university or institute for Indian undergraduates (May–July 2027).
eligibility: Indian nationals in science, engineering or maths at a DAAD WISE partner institution in India; a signed invitation letter from a German professor is needed.
title: DAAD WISE 2027 (Germany)

prize.description: Monthly DAAD stipend plus travel allowance (reported figures vary, roughly €750–€861 per month).

notes: Deadline conflicts across sources (1 Nov vs late Nov); confirm on daad.in. The DAAD portal opens about 6 weeks before the deadline.
Students at non-partner institutions are not eligible.
support: Travel allowance and insurance reported · stipend covers living costs
